perState.idle: Stable guard breathing; small head tilt; wrap returns guard.
perState.punch: Wind-up, full right extension, guard recovery.
perState.kick: Knee lift, right lateral extension, bent-leg recovery.
perState.hurt: Rear recoil, deeper recoil, forward recovery, guard.
perState.jump: Grounded preparation and landing flank tucked airborne poses; gi has modest blue-green lighting drift.
perState.special: Rear fist charge and open palm right strike distinct.
perState.walk: Alternating raised feet and passing stance read as guarded locomotion; last-first stances close. Experimental locomotion visually passes.
perState.block: Guard rises to covered face and hold; face partly intentionally occluded.
perState.crouch: Progressive squat; anatomy remains adult after runtime head-scale adjustment.
perState.ko: Recoil, knee collapse, side fall, fully lying terminal pose. Head measurement follows rotated anatomical axis.
perState.celebrate: Guard, relaxed belt stance, raised fist, sustained victory.
perState.airPunch: Both feet tucked off-ground with clear arm extension; different from grounded crouch.
perState.airKick: Tucked airborne chamber, unfolding, full right extension, retraction.
perState.crouchPunch: Planted low guard to right punch and recovery.
perState.crouchKick: Deep planted squat, knee chamber, low extended kick, recovery.
perState.uppercut: Wind-up and high upward fist; smaller export in peak calibrated via head scale.
perState.sweep: Low chamber, outward leg sweep, hand-braced low extension, return.
perState.dash: Forward lean and alternating foot push then recovery; readable fast stride.
perState.backwalk: Right-facing guard retained with reverse stepping; seam close. Experimental locomotion visually passes.
perState.lowBlock: Deep planted squat; fists cover face then upper guard.
perState.turn: Replacement passes: right profile → near front → left three-quarter → left guard; continuous directional progression, stable identity/anatomy.
perState.land: Deep impact squat to standing guard; scales calibrated.
perState.jumpForward: Forward push-off, bent-leg flight, tucked apex, landing extension; foot-ground contact supplied by runtime positioning.
perState.super: Two-hand charge, rotation, double-palm right extension, recovery.
